heroHeadline: Banking Regulator Chief Resigns as Fund Scandal Widens; Erdoğan Warns of Collapsing World Order
heroSubtitle: Şahap Kavcıoğlu quit as the investment-fund probe passed 120 detentions, after the SPK chief left in October. On Nov 18 Erdoğan told AK Party lawmakers the old world order is collapsing.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (AP, Reuters, BBC, Washington Post, Euronews, Foreign Policy, Balkan Insight, Turkish Minute, Türkiye Today), Socialist International statements, and US State Department readouts.
